rawVariants.rawRef: RFC-953 K. Harrenstien, M. Stahl, E. Feinler, "HOSTNAME Server", RFC-953 , SRI, October 1985. This RFC contains the official specification of the hostname server protocol, which is obsoleted by the DNS. This TCP based protocol accesses information stored in the RFC-952 format, and is used to obtain copies of the host table.
DNS:5 "Hostname Server," K. Harrenstein, M. Stahl, E. Feinler, RFC-953 , October 1985.
